notes.title: Celebrating 12 years of Draknek & Friends - Steam Publisher Sale
notes.notes: [p]Have you heard the news? This week* is the 12th anniversary of Draknek and Friends! 🎉[/p][p][i]*technically it's tricky to pinpoint the exact date we were founded, but it's been 12 years since the first release of our first game, [url="https://sokobond.com/"]Sokobond[/url]. So this seems the most plausible time to celebrate our anniversary![/i][/p][p]With the 5 year anniversary of [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1052990/A_Monsters_Expedition/"]A Monster's Expedition[/url] next month too, we have a bunch of exciting things happening this month and next. Check them out:[/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37052424/05b2c24b1803e02223891e432863b37ecf209edf.png"][/img][/p][h2]12th Anniversary Sale on Steam[/h2][p]To kick things off, here on Steam we're running an official publisher sale for the next two weeks.[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/draknek/sale/Draknek12Years" style="button"]store.steampowered.com/publisher/draknek/sale/Draknek12Years[/url][/p][p]This sale includes all the games we've developed, published, and the new demo for our upcoming game, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3352310/Spooky_Express/"]Spooky Express[/url].[/p][p]It also features some of our deepest discounts yet, so now is an excellent time to pick up a new game.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37052424/36ffa0a84db758d7cacddecbbcb07b32c2035e82.png"][/img][/p][h2]Humble Bundle - Draknek & Friends: 12 Years of Great Puzzle Games![/h2][p]Running until September 19th, this [url="https://www.humblebundle.com/games/draknek-and-friends-12th-anniversary-celebration"]12th Anniversary Draknek & Friends Humble Bundle[/url] is the first time you've ever been able to get all our games in one place this cheaply. These bundles support The Trevor Project - the leading suicide prevention and crisis intervention nonprofit organization for LGBTQ+ young people. Pay what you like, get some great games, and support a charity along the way. The bundles are:[/p][list][*][p][b]$5 for 4 Draknek & Friends games[/b][/p][list][*][p](Electrifying Incident, Sokobond, Cosmic Express and A Good Snowman)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]$10 for 6 Draknek & Friends games[/b][/p][list][*][p](the previously included games, Sokobond Express, and Bonfire Peaks)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]$15 for the Entire 8 game bundle[/b][/p][list][*][p](the previously included games, LOK Digital, and A Monster's Expedition[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37052424/b9f7a0bfc6053c7de6fa00eb7ae45b05c70e5203.png"][/img][/p][h2]12 Years of Draknek, 12 Free Copies of Draknek Games![/h2][p]To celebrate 12 years, we're also giving away 12 copies of Draknek & Friends games. To enter, sign up to our mailing list by heading to [url="https://giveaway.draknek.org/"]this link[/url], and winners will be chosen on Friday 5th September.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]In other Draknek & Friends news:[/p][list][*][p][url="https://spooky.express/"]Spooky Express[/url] will be launching October 21st, don't forget to [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3352310/Spooky_Express/"]wishlist on Steam[/url], and pre-order on [url="http://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=express.spooky"]Android[/url] or [url="http://apps.apple.com/app/id6738424828"]iOS[/url]![/p][/*][*][p]Bonfire Peaks is taking part in the [url="https://itch.io/b/2979/play-for-peace-games-for-palestine-2025-charity-bundle"]Play for Peace - Games for Palestine 2025 Charity Bundle[/url] on itch.io[/p][/*][*][p]Sokobond Express is taking part in the [url="https://itch.io/b/3171/game-devs-of-color-support-bundle"]Game Devs of Color Support Bundle[/url] on itch.io[/p][/*][*][p]The [url="https://grants.draknek.org/"]Draknek New Voices Puzzle Grant[/url] is accepting applications until September 28th[/p][/*][/list][p]That's all for now! Until next time.[/p]

notes.title: We're excited to announce the next game from Draknek & Friends: Spooky Express
notes.notes:
Hey there!

If you enjoyed [i]A Monster's Expedition[/i], then you might also enjoy what we've been working on lately here at Draknek & Friends.

Announcing: [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3352310/Spooky_Express/]Spooky Express[/url][/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7938465/83e82ab61856c744ba366a8e814e5b0fc8468bd8.png[/img]

Plan the train route for the world’s spookiest theme park!
All the passengers are all just [i]dying[/i] to ride the Spooky Express.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7938465/ae096275ed36a1d1ae8b7fd51d4e66ba6d0c68c1.gif[/img]

Pick up the creepy cryptids and drop them at their destinations around the park. But be careful! Don’t let them scare or bite the human passengers. Stay [i]on track[/i] of the situation or you’ll have a [i]grave[/i] problem.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3352310/Spooky_Express/

Spooky Express is great follow-up to our other award-winning thinky puzzle game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/583270/Cosmic_Express/]Cosmic Express[/url] and will feature over 100 unique levels with countless monsters, maps and mechanics.

If that sounds like something you might be interested in, please give us a wishlist on Steam, or share the trailer below.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uewJWzD6s10

...And that's not all. If you want to hear even more about Spooky Express, we've just released a special episode of the [url=https://www.draknek.org/podcast]Draknek & Friends Official Podcast[/url]. Tune in wherever you get your podcasts to hear creative director Alan Hazelden and producer Syrenne McNulty chat to the level designer Lucas Le Slo about the development of the game, and some of the other projects he's involved in.

Until next time 👋

notes.title: LOK Digital is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Hey there,

We have some exciting news about another game being published by us at Draknek & Friends:

LOK Digital is OUT NOW. We just announced it in the [b]Day of the Devs: The Game Awards Edition[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43162523/daa3d454ab03508a98c4d81d84e9b9d3be5262ae.png[/img]

Bring the LOK creatures to life by spelling words that shape their world. They can only live on blackened tiles, so by solving puzzles you're expanding their horizons and helping their civilization thrive.

notes.title: New Game Announcement: LOK Digital
notes.notes:
Hey there!

If you enjoyed playing A Monster's Expedition, we think you'll love what we've been working on lately. Combining creative [i]thinky puzzles[/i], intuitive mechanics, and an elegant hand-drawn art style... We're pleased to announce the new game we're publishing this year is [b]LOK Digital[/b].

Discover magical words, and learn their rules as you go as each of these words has their own special ability to change the world around you. As the game evolves and ramps up the challenge delight in surprises as the shifting puzzles and introducing new words and unexpected ways they work together to elevate the gameplay.

⬛ Intuitive mechanics and many special words to find and learn
⬜ Elegant, hand-drawn art style and meditative, entrancing soundtrack
⬛ Learn deep, surprising, and unexpected mechanics that simultaneously challenge and delight
⬜ Based on the critically acclaimed puzzle book, LOK

notes.title: Sokobond Express is available today!
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to share that Sokobond Express, a beautifully minimalist puzzle game that combines chemical bonds and puzzling pathfinding in novel ways, is out on Steam now. Please enjoy and leave a Steam review!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1701330/Sokobond_Express/

Sokobond Express is developed by José Hernández, a first time commercial developer living in Venezuela. After several years of hard work and refining the game until it felt just right, Hernández is excited for players to finally be able to play it.

“Working on Sokobond Express for the last three years has been a real joy. I think the hardest thing to pull off in the game was the pacing - making levels get progressively harder while remaining engaging took a really long time. We spent a lot of time redesigning early-game levels to make them the perfect difficulty. We're really proud of how things ended up, so please check it out!”- José Hernández

If you’re a fan of other Draknek games, we know Sokobond Express  will be right up your alley. 
It combines the pathfinding of Cosmic Express with the deep but elegant atom building from Sokobond - paying homage to its predecessors while also being an elegant and entrancing game of its own.

Finally, the game is Steam Deck verified. Whether you're playing on Windows, macOS, Linux, or the Steam Deck, the game should provide a native and excellent play experience.

We can’t wait for you to play this puzzle masterpiece.

Thanks,
Draknek & Friends

notes.title: A Monster's Expedition on Switch is Sunday morning heaven
notes.notes:
I do love coming back to good games. A Monster's Expedition is a wonderful game, and it's wonderful to revisit on the Switch. You have an idea in your head about games like this, which you might not play for many months at a time, and the second go round is always about filling in the gaps.

What I remember about A Monster's Expedition, for instance, is how nice it feels to push down trees: a funny, brisk little shove, a plonk, a thud. But I forgot how good it feels to roll them into place, the little thrum of the harp - or maybe it's piano keys, I'm forgetting already - when you step onto the new island. And the way the surrounding mist teases distant things, windmills, lighthouses, a giant diamond ring? And then rolls back, brain-fog cleared.

What I also remember is the comedy, which is consistently funny in a gentle kind of way, describing strange human objects from a monsters-eye view. And the way the game is purposefully slow, letting you dangle your legs in the water of any island's edge, grab a coffee from the odd machine, and reset your island - which is essential in any good Sokoban game (Sokoban is the old Japanese crate-pushing game that the classic Pokémon boulder puzzles were based on, and also what A Monster's Expedition, and others from developer Draknek, is based on too). But you forget the quickness of it.

notes.title: A Monster's Expedition review
notes.notes:
A Monster’s Expedition review
A Monster’s Expedition is a very well crafted, chill puzzle game that will make you feel very clever indeed.

  • Developer: Draknek & Friends
  • Publisher: Draknek
  • Release: Out now
  • On: Windows, Mac OS X
  • From: Steam, Humble, Itch
  • Price: £15.50/€16.80/$20

I think that I owe myself an apology. I have always thought that I was no good at these sorts of spatially-based push-em-up puzzles. But A Monster’s Expedition, which is entirely made up of them, has challenged that assumption purely through the power of great teaching. It’s all well and good when these brainteasers are tossed context-free into other games as Pokémon gyms or Professor Layton stepping stones, but they’ve got nothing on A Monster’s Expedition’s gentle coaxing of understanding.
